transactioncolumncustomfield.description: Target dressed thickness for a planed line, e.g. 15/16. Free text rather than a list: the trader screen offers the common thicknesses but also an "other" box, because the dressed thicknesses in the prototype are ours and have never been confirmed by the client.
transactioncolumncustomfield.help: The thickness the mill should plane to, e.g. 15/16 from a 4/4 board. Only meaningful when Reman: Planing is ticked.
transactioncolumncustomfield.label: Planing Target Thickness
